newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - July 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - July 6.

text.p: The following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Friday, as reported by Kyodo news agency:
-- Four executives of Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd arrested in payoff scandal.
-- The government plans to dismantle Donen's nuclear fuel reprocessing plant at Tokaimura.
-- Killer sends letter to local newspaper claiming responsibility for murder of 11-year-old boy.
-- Former executives of Nomura Securities Co Ltd questioned.
